verdict.rationale: Omarchy has a built-in 'Omarchy Menu > Install' system for adding development environments and other software, and ships with many popular apps (Zoom, Spotify, Steam, Minecraft) pre-installed; a hands-on reviewer confirms 'Installing software is easy and lightning-fast.' However, this is a keyboard-driven menu/script system ('Everything in Omarchy happens via the keyboard') rather than a literal single-click GUI app store, so it delivers the underlying capability with a different interaction model than the story specifies.
